high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram profile for the account "degreesoffreedomco." The profile belongs to an artist named Degrees of Freedom, who specializes in designing products inspired by origami, aerospace, and mathematics. The account has 329 posts, 449K followers, and is following 290 accounts. The bio describes the artist's work as creating products in motion, available on their website in limited runs. It invites viewers to visit their website at www.enjoydof.com to see what moves them. The profile picture features a stylized origami-like design with a pink and orange border
